terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: CryptoPro Trader is an educational, autonomous paper-crypto spot trading cockpit. It ships in paper spot trading mode by default and connects to Alpaca's paper trading API, which simulates order execution with no real funds at risk.
terms.p2: No live trading. This application never places an order on a live brokerage account. Setting the trading mode to "Live" makes it read-only: it may display balances, positions, orders and prices from your own live Alpaca keys for insight, but order placement and portfolio management are available in paper mode only.
terms.p3: No financial advice. Nothing in this application — including signal scores, journal entries, research notes, or news/socials aggregation — constitutes investment, financial, legal, or tax advice. Historical or simulated performance shown in this app is not indicative of future results.
terms.p4: No warranty. This software is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including but not limited to fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, or uninterrupted operation. The creator is not liable for any losses, direct or indirect, arising from use of this application.
terms.p5: Your responsibility. By running the agent, adjusting risk limits, or connecting brokerage credentials, you acknowledge and accept these risks and agree that you are trading at your own discretion and risk.
terms.p6: Billing & cancellation. CryptoPro Trader is a Pro-tier feature, billed and processed by Patreon as a monthly subscription — not by us. Patreon calculates, collects and remits VAT or sales tax where required, so the price shown may already include it depending on where you live. Manage or cancel your membership on Patreon, not in this app; cancelling takes effect at the end of the billing period you already paid for, and Trader stays available until then. Refunds are handled by Patreon under its own refund policy — contact Patreon within 60 days of a charge; a period you've already used is not normally refunded.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introHtml: CryptoPro is operated by VibeSoft Studio, Kronenland 1116, 6605 RB Wijchen, Netherlands (info@vibesoftstudio.com). This policy covers CryptoPro Suite, Charts, Trader and Training, which share one account and one database. It explains what we store, why, and what you can do about it.
privacy.s1Html:
Your account: username, a hashed password (never the password itself), and — only if you switch it on — a two-factor secret. You may add a notification email; it is stored but nothing sends email yet.
What you create: watchlists, chart layouts and drawings, settings, your chosen theme and language, course progress and quiz results, and Trader's trading journal and paper-trading state.
Broker keys: if you connect Alpaca, your API credentials are encrypted before they are stored. Trader places paper orders only.
We do not collect payment card details, and we do not ask for special-category data.
If you link Patreon: your Patreon member ID, your tier and pledge status, and the date your paid period ends. We never see your card details — the pledge is made and charged on patreon.com.
privacy.s2Title: Why, and on what legal basis
privacy.s2Html: To provide the account and the features you asked for (performance of a contract), and to keep the account secure — sessions, optional two-factor, and write limits on credential changes (legitimate interest). We do not profile you, we do not make automated decisions about you, and we do not use your data to train anything.
privacy.s3Html:
One cookie. cpc_session is set only when you sign in. It is HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production, and valid for 30 days or until you sign out. It identifies your session and nothing else — and the same cookie is shared across every CryptoPro Suite app (Suite, Charts, Training), so signing in once signs you in everywhere.
Local storage keeps your own preferences on your device — theme, language, last open tab, watchlists, and in Trader the API keys you entered.
No analytics, no advertising, no tracking pixels, no social media embeds and no third-party cookies. Fonts and chart libraries are served from our own servers, so opening a page does not tell anyone else that you were here.
privacy.s4Html: Hosting: Vercel. Database: Supabase. Both process data on our instructions only. If you connect Alpaca, requests go to Alpaca using your own keys. Subscriptions: Patreon, and only if you choose to link it. We then read your membership of our campaign — member ID, tier and pledge status. Patreon is the merchant of record: it takes the payment and handles VAT, and your card details never reach us. Unlinking removes our copy; cancelling the pledge itself happens on Patreon. Nothing is sold, rented, or shared for advertising.
privacy.s5Html: For as long as your account exists. Deleting your account (Account → Danger zone) ends every session immediately and blocks sign-in across the whole suite; the data is then permanently erased after 30 days. Sign-in sessions expire after 30 days on their own.
privacy.s6Html: You can ask for access, correction, erasure, restriction, objection, or a portable copy of your data — and you can delete your account yourself at any time, without asking us. Write to info@vibesoftstudio.com for anything else. You also have the right to complain to your national data protection authority (in the Netherlands, the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
privacy.s7Html: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it. Material changes will be announced in the app.
